title: Meghalaya Biodiversity Board (MBB)
passage: MCQs based on the 'About Us' section of the Official Website of the Meghalaya Biodiversity Board.

questions.question: The Meghalaya Biodiversity Board was established under which Act?
questions.solution: The Meghalaya Biodiversity Board is a statutory body constituted under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.

questions.question: The Meghalaya Biodiversity Board functions under which government?

options.d: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

questions.solution: The Board functions under the Government of Meghalaya.

questions.question: Biodiversity refers to the variability among
questions.solution: Biodiversity includes variability among all living organisms from all sources.

questions.question: Biodiversity includes diversity within species, between species and of
questions.solution: The three levels are genetic, species and ecosystem diversity.

questions.question: Meghalaya forms part of which global biodiversity hotspot?
questions.solution: Meghalaya lies within the Indo-Burma biodiversity hotspot.

questions.question: Meghalaya lies in a biogeographic transition zone between
questions.solution: Meghalaya is a transition zone connecting Indian, Indo-Malayan and Indo-Chinese regions.

questions.question: One major function of the Meghalaya Biodiversity Board is to

options.b: Regulate commercial use of biological resources

questions.solution: The Board regulates access to and commercial utilization of biological resources.

questions.question: The Meghalaya Biodiversity Board advises the State Government on
questions.solution: Advisory role includes biodiversity conservation and sustainable use policies.

questions.question: The term equitable sharing of benefits mainly refers to

options.c: Fair sharing of benefits with local communities

questions.solution: Benefit sharing ensures local and indigenous communities receive fair benefits.

questions.question: Which document is prepared regularly by the Meghalaya Biodiversity Board?
questions.solution: The Board prepares annual reports as part of its statutory duties.

questions.question: The Meghalaya Biodiversity Board is best described as a
questions.solution: It is a statutory body established by law.

questions.question: The Indo-Burma biodiversity hotspot is known for
questions.solution: Indo-Burma is globally recognized for high biodiversity and endemism.
